Sticker album sounds

The following Freesound field recordings are dedicated to the public domain
under Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

sticker-bark.wav
Dog bark 2, recorded by Sadiquecat
https://freesound.org/people/Sadiquecat/sounds/850823/

sticker-meow.wav
Cat Meow2.wav, recorded by steffcaffrey
https://freesound.org/people/steffcaffrey/sounds/262313/

sticker-tweet.wav
Single Bird Chirp, recorded by Allan Legemaate (alegemaate)
https://freesound.org/people/alegemaate/sounds/233255/

sticker-quack.wav
single quack from a duck, edited by Mikes-MultiMedia
https://freesound.org/people/Mikes-MultiMedia/sounds/418509/
Original field recording ducks1.wav, by squashy555 (CC0)
https://freesound.org/people/squashy555/sounds/244329/

sticker-cluck.wav
Chicken, recorded by D4XX
https://freesound.org/people/D4XX/sounds/607245/

The game uses short mono excerpts with gentle fades and adjusted levels.
The bark, quack, and tweet each repeat with a small pitch variation.
The bell, brass, chime, clop, hop, pluck, and splash were synthesized
specifically for this game.
